title: DocuMindRetrievalEvaluationDataset
description: JSON schema for DocuMind IR evaluation queries and ground-truth chunk relevance annotations.

is_placeholder_dataset.description: Flag indicating if the dataset contains template/placeholder labels rather than verified ground-truth.

queries.description: List of evaluation queries with ground-truth relevant chunk IDs.

question.description: The exact user question to evaluate.

relevant_chunk_ids.description: List of chunk IDs that contain relevant evidence answering the question.

reference_answer.description: Authoritative human-written reference answer for evaluating answer quality and correctness.

document_id.description: Optional document name or identifier where chunks originate.

notes.description: Optional rationale explaining why the designated chunks are relevant.
